title: Last Day to Mail Holiday Cards in Canada (2026)
description: Canada Post's 2026 send-by dates for cards and letters in Canada, the U.S. and overseas, and how to allow for a printed letter ordered online.
keywords: last day to mail christmas cards canada
answer: Canada Post's send-by dates for cards are December 22 for local mail, December 21 for regional and December 18 for national. Cards to the United States should go by December 11, and overseas cards by December 3 to 11 depending on the destination. These are estimates, not guarantees, so post early.

blocks.p: Canada Post notes that these dates are between major urban centres and depend on the origin and destination, and that some restrictions apply. Local, regional and national refer to how far the letter travels, which sets its delivery standard of two, three or four business days. See [how long a letter takes in Canada](/blog/how-long-does-a-letter-take-in-canada).

rows: United Kingdom, France, Germany, Netherlands, Switzerland, Japan
Rest of Europe, Asia, Australia, New Zealand, China, India, Middle East
Africa, Central and South America, Caribbean

blocks.p: International delivery times vary by country and by customs and local postal service, so treat these as the latest dates, not safe ones.

Canada Post's Santa Claus letters are addressed to Santa Claus, North Pole, H0H 0H0, Canada. Canada Post asks that letters arrive by December 9, 2026 to receive a reply from the North Pole, and no stamp is needed.

sections.h2: If you are ordering a printed letter online

blocks.p: A letter ordered through sendletter is printed and posted with Canada Post. Allow one business day for printing and posting, then add the Canada Post delivery standard of two to four business days. To arrive before the send-by date, order a few days ahead of it. See [what an online letter costs](/blog/what-an-online-letter-costs) and [how online letter mailing works](/blog/how-online-letter-mailing-works).

sections.h2: Check before you rely on a date

blocks.p: Canada Post can update these dates, and delivery standards are estimates that it does not guarantee. Confirm on Canada Post's holiday sending page before the last week.
